Run For The Ribbon

The Rotaract Club of BMS Yelahanka is organising Run for the Ribbon, a 5K walkathon/run held as part of Pink October, our Breast Cancer Awareness Week.

Join us for a morning of movement, community, and strength as we come together in support of the cause🩷

📅 Date: 11th October 2026
⏰ Time: 6:00 AM
📍 Venue: BMSIT&M, Yelahanka

Open to all — this walkathon welcomes participants across a wider age bracket, from students to senior citizens, all walking together for breast cancer awareness. 
100% of the money collected through registrations will go towards this cause.

Every step is more than just a stride — it's a small act of support for someone's fight🩷

Medals, Certificates and Badges will be provided!
5 AICTE points will be awarded to the participants.
